id: title:Gilbert09:classify impersonation token creator denial as non retryable

review.posthog_relevance: BigQuery warehouse ingestion reliability and IAM permission handling
review.reason: Adds a specific, non-retryable error classification for Google Cloud IAM permission denial (`iam.serviceAccounts.getAccessToken`) and a corresponding unit test. This could help PostHog's BigQuery warehouse ingestion avoid retrying requests that will fail due to missing IAM permissions, potentially improving reliability and reducing unnecessary API calls.
review.uncertainty: The benefit relies on the assumption that this specific permission denial is a common failure mode for PostHog's BigQuery ingestion and that distinguishing it from retryable errors is not currently handled. No production incident or adoption data is provided.
